name: Add HasAnySuffix helper + tests
prompt:
In package backend/common, implement a new helper:

  func HasAnySuffix(src string, suffixes ...string) bool

It should return true if src has any of the given suffixes (use strings.HasSuffix), otherwise false — mirror the style of HasPrefixes. Add unit tests in util_test.go covering positive and negative cases. Run `go test ./backend/common/ -count=1` until green. Do not break existing tests. Do not commit or push.
